decision: Agent Company 0.5.1: council fixes and guard hardening

seats.name: Owner's goal
seats.stance: B: covers the 0.5.0 fix list, but the repo-wide claims check still exits 1 on the 0.5.0 brief, and the owner asked for a clean seal.

BLOCKING: a test for claims over a repo with a council folder
seal states or runs the repo-wide check

seats.name: Breaker
seats.stance: B: 24 of 27 hostile commands got past the 0.5.1 guard, including a settings rewrite through a glob and real data read through variables, braces, moves and git.
fixes: BLOCKING: globs checked against harness and .git
BLOCKING: refuse shell expansion in paths; check VAR=value
BLOCKING: no git exemption for harness paths
BLOCKING: refuse moving or deleting parents of harness or real data
BLOCKING: curl --data-urlencode @ and -K
BLOCKING: git rebase -x, bisect run, --upload-pack, grep -O; find -exec, awk system
git branch -f on protected names; case-insensitive protected names
tests for all 24

seats.name: Claims officer
seats.stance: B: counts match, but four statements are not backed: the repo-wide claims check, 'every spelling' of uploads, seal accepting edits after scoring, and owner switches that don't exist.
fixes: BLOCKING: claims exits 0 repo-wide, with a test
BLOCKING: list tested upload spellings instead of 'every spelling'
BLOCKING: seal refuses a hand-edited verdict.md
hash-based change check
council gate switches in the inbox README

seats.name: Guardian
seats.stance: B: 'cd data && cat real/r.csv' still reaches real data because relative paths resolve from the project root; real data can be committed and read back through git; the harness folder can be moved or deleted.
fixes: BLOCKING: resolve paths from the call's folder; refuse cd chained with reads
BLOCKING: keep real data out of git (.gitignore, add -f, show/grep/archive)
BLOCKING: protect parent folders of the harness and ~/.claude settings
curl -K, mv and diff on real-data folders
gh posts that claim approval
gh api -XGET crash
